notes.title: Settings Hot-Fix
notes.content:
Thankyou for all the initial feedback! A lot of you have mentioned the necessity for functional sound settings, so here they are!

[b]PLEASE DELETE SAVE DATA IN SETTINGS, UNDER GAMEPLAY TAB FOR CHANGES TO TAKE EFFECT![/b]

[h3]Sound Setting Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Setup background logic for saving settings data
[*] Fixed sound settings bars being misaligned
[*] Fixed sound settings not saving their volume properly
[*] Fixed sound settings bars not being in the correct position (please delete data in gameplay settings for these changes to take effect)
[*] Fixed settings buttons showing thin outline
[*] Fixed certain sounds not adjusting with volume control
[/list]

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed being able to resume game while in settings
[*] Fixed pause screen duplication (can no longer press escape to unpause game)
[*] Removed items from upgrades that have not yet been fully implemented
[*] Increased width of the outline shader
[*] Fixed VSync button being stretched
[*] Fixed settings buttons showing thin outline
[/list]
[i]And thankyou for your support :)[/i]

notes.title: Hello Playtesters!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first of hopefully many updates for the Cocoa Loco Playtest build!

This update adds a few small quality of life features to help with playtesting:
[list]
[*] Added a welcome pop-up screen when players first launch the game
[*] Added buttons that link to an online feedback form
[/list]
